question: Which is taller, Burj Khalifa or the Shanghai Tower, and what is the height difference in metres?

subquestions: What is the official height (in metres) of the Burj Khalifa?
What is the official height (in metres) of the Shanghai Tower?

args.query: official height of Burj Khalifa metres 828
official height of Shanghai Tower in metres 632
Burj Khalifa height 828 meters Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat CTBUH official
official height of Burj Khalifa metres 828

observations.content:
[1] Burj Khalifa - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burj_Khalifa
    Designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, it is the world's tallest structure, with a total height of 829.8 m (2,722 ft, or just over half a mile) and a roof height (excluding the antenna, but including a 242.6 m spire) [2] of 828 m (2,717 ft).

[2] Burj Khalifa Facts 2026: Height, Floors, Cost, Architect ...
    https://tickets-burjkhalifa.com/plan-your-visit/facts-about-burj-khalifa/
    Burj Khalifa stands at 828 metres (2,717 feet) — the world’s tallest building since its inauguration on 4 January 2010. It has 163 floors above ground, 2 basement levels, and 57 elevators. Construction began in 2004 and took approximately 6 years, involving a peak workforce of 12,000 workers on site each day.

[3] Burj Khalifa Height and Floors: The Honest Stats · TBC
    https://tallestbuildingscouncil.org/articles/burj-khalifa-honest-stats
    Jul 22, 2026 · The world's tallest building is genuinely impressive - once you understand what the 828-metre figure actually measures. Burj Khalifa's official height is 828 metres (2,717 feet). This is the architectural top - the tip of the central spire. The highest floor you can reach by elevator is floor 148, At The Top SKY, at 585.4 metres (1,921 feet).

[4] Burj Khalifa: How Many Floors, Height, Cost & Views Guide
    https://illustrarch.com/articles/69944-burj-khalifa-architecture.html
    Feb 7, 2026 · Standing at 828 meters with 163 floors, the Burj Khalifa in the United Arab Emirates is the world's tallest building.

[5] Burj Khalifa Height in Meters and Feet: Structural Facts and ...
    https://build-construct.com/building/burj-khalifa-height-in-meters-and-feet-structural-facts-and-engineering-milestones/
    Jul 1, 2026 · The Burj Khalifa in Dubai stands as the tallest artificial free-standing structure ever built, with a total tip height of 829.8 meters (2,722 feet) and an architectural height of 828 meters (2,717 feet). For context, this iconic skyscraper is roughly twice the height of the Empire State Building.

args.query: official height of Shanghai Tower in metres 632

observations.content:
[1] Shanghai Tower - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanghai_Tower
    The Shanghai Tower[a] is a 128-story, 632-meter-tall (2,073-foot) megatall skyscraper located in Lujiazui, Pudong, Shanghai. [9] It is currently the tallest building in China, the world's third-tallest building by height to architectural top, and the world's second-tallest building by height to highest occupied floor.

[2] List of tallest buildings in Shanghai - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tallest_buildings_in_Shanghai
    Since 2015, the tallest building in Shanghai has been the 632 m (2,073 ft) tall, 128-story Shanghai Tower, one of only four megatall skyscrapers. At the time of its completion, it was the second-tallest building in the world; it is currently the third tallest.

[3] Shanghai Tower Height: Facts, Tips & Why It's 632 Meters
    https://gochinacompass.com/630/Shanghai_Tower_Height:_Facts,_Tips_Why_It's_632_Meters.html
    Standing at a definitive 632 meters (2,073 feet), the Shanghai Tower isn't just China's tallest building; it's a statement of engineering ambition and a defining feature of the Lujiazui skyline.

[4] Shanghai Tower – size comparison & facts | Size Explorer
    https://www.size-explorer.com/en/compare/buildings/shanghai+tower/
    Shanghai Tower is a 632-meter supertall skyscraper in the Lujiazui area of Pudong, Shanghai. It is the tallest building in China and one of the tallest in the world. The tower has 128 floors and was completed in 2015.

[5] Shanghai Tower: Height And Sustainability Facts | Institution ...
    https://www.ice.org.uk/what-is-civil-engineering/infrastructure-projects/shanghai-tower
    The Shanghai Tower is a 632m (2,074ft) high, 128-storey skyscraper in the Lujiazui finance and trade zone of Shanghai in China. It was completed in 2015 and officially opened to the public in 2016.

observations.content:
[1] CTBUH Presents the ten tallest buildings completed in 2009
    https://newsletter.ctbuh.org/eblast/BurjKhalifa/BurjKhalifaHeight.html
    Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat ratifies official height and “World’s Tallest” status of the Burj Khalifa.

    https://www.size-explorer.com/en/compare/buildings/Petronas+Towers/Burj+Khalifa
    According to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH)'s official definition and ranking, they were the tallest buildings in the world from 1998 to 2004 when they were surpassed by Taipei 101.

    https://storage.googleapis.com/tpjoibcwskgrqopiw/burj-khalifa-in-meters-height.html
    When we talk about the Burj Khalifa's height in meters, we're referring to its total architectural height, which includes its spire. The building's official height, as verified by the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH), is an astounding 828 meters (2,716 feet).

    https://nzreview.org/blog/how-tall-is-burj-khalifa/
    The Burj Khalifa’s official architectural height — measured to the top of the spire — is 828 meters (2,717 feet) according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH), the global authority on building height.

answer:
The Burj Khalifa is taller than the Shanghai Tower by **196 metres**. [S1][S6][S11]

- **Burj Khalifa official height:** **829.8 m** [S1]  
- **Shanghai Tower official height:** **632 m** [S6]  
- **Height difference:** 829.8 − 632 = **197.8 m** (≈ **198 m**) [S1][S6]
